title: Android Developer (Java) (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is a forward-thinking technology company specializing in innovative mobile solutions. We work on cutting-edge projects that emphasize user-centric design, scalability, and seamless performance. Join our fully remote team and contribute to developing high-quality Android applications using Java, while collaborating in an agile environment.
Position Overview We are seeking a skilled Android Developer to join our team. You'll build and maintain scalable mobile applications using modern Android development technologies, with a strong emphasis on test-driven development and API integration.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop native Android applications using Java and modern Android frameworks
  • Design and implement robust mobile architectures following best practices
  • Practice test-driven development for reliable and maintainable code
  • Integrate with RESTful APIs and backend services
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and participate in code reviews
  • Optimize application performance and ensure smooth user experiences
Required Technical Skills Android Development
  • Java for Android (required) - native Android app development using Java with Android SDK
  • Kotlin (preferred) - modern Android development language
  • Android Runtime (ART) and Android SDK fundamentals
  • Android Studio IDE proficiency
  • Android Jetpack components (ViewModel, LiveData, Room, Navigation)
  • Material Design guidelines and UI/UX principles
  • Responsive layouts and multi-device support
  • Java/Kotlin interoperability in mixed codebases
Architecture & Patterns
  • MVVM, MVP, or Clean Architecture
  • Dependency injection (Dagger, Hilt)
  • Reactive programming (RxJava, Coroutines, Flow)
  • Repository pattern and data layer design
Backend Integration
  • RESTful API consumption (Retrofit, OkHttp)
  • JSON parsing and data serialization
  • Authentication and authorization implementation
  • GraphQL (nice to have)
Testing & DevOps
  • Test-driven development methodology
  • Testing frameworks: JUnit, Espresso, Mockito, Robolectric
  • Unit, integration, and UI testing
  • CI/CD pipeline setup (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Jenkins)
  • Version control with Git
Data & Storage
  • SQLite and Room database
  • SharedPreferences and DataStore
  • Local caching strategies
  • Firebase integration (Firestore, Realtime Database)
Nice to Have
  • React Native experience for cross-platform development
  • Flutter knowledge
  • Jetpack Compose for modern UI development
  • Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging)
  • In-app purchases and subscription management
  • Google Play Store publishing and release management
  • Push notifications implementation
  • Deep linking and app navigation
  • Performance profiling and optimization tools
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3+ years of professional Android development experience
  • Published apps on Google Play Store
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Understanding of mobile app security best practices
  • Experience with offline-first architecture

title: 销售经理
description:
Job Responsibilities:

1、Sales and business development: Promote the sales of our storage, home energy storage systems in several local countries and achieve and exceed sales targets. Develop and implement sales strategies to expand market share and revenue growth.

2、Market Analysis and Strategy: Conduct thorough market analysis to identify sales opportunities and develop strategic plans that leverage market trends and customer insights. Stay up to date on the latest industry developments to inform and enhance sales plans.

3、Customer and Distributor Relationship Management: Establish and maintain strong, long-term relationships with customers, provide tailored solutions to meet their unique needs and ensure customer satisfaction.

4、Collaboration and reporting: Work closely with product development teams to align sales strategies with company goals. Regularly report sales progress and market insights to senior management.


Qualifications

1、Sales expertise: Have at least 5 years or more of successful sales experience in home energy storage systems, and have a deep understanding and successful experience in distribution models.

2、Strategic planning: Ability to analyze the market, identify opportunities and develop effective sales strategies to achieve business goals.

3、Have deep channel management experience and marketing resources;

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, etc.);
  • Boas práticas de segurança e qualidade de código;
  • Atuação em metodologias ágeis.


Seu papel será:

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: Software Development Manager
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive Software Development Manager to lead our engineering team. In this role, you will oversee daily operations, provide strategic leadership, and drive initiatives to enhance service delivery and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise with strong people management.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Management role within Encora Brazil Division Global Solutions Team;
  • Technical leadership: Lead complex and multi-disciplinary projects, help the team with problem solving by offering suggestions, technical guidelines and feedback, ensure quality, performance and security. Deliver results and challenge the team, actively working in technical discussions, architecture and other decisions, focused on Development routines;
  • Project Management: ensure valuable deliveries, timeline, ceremonies, project metrics, remove blocks, manage risks, report project status, collect and apply lessons learned, propose changes to the existing SW Development process to achieve better results;
  • People Management: evaluations, IDP, feedback, 1:1, ensure processes are followed, improve productivity, technical and soft skills, motivate the team, provide career direction, hiring and dismissal process, ability to retain talents;
  • Relationship management with multiple stakeholders (both technical and business), taking accountability to deliver software solutions and getting development team’s commitment;
  • Suggest and promote process improvements.



Essential Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or other related areas or equivalent work experience;
  • Experience with Software Development;
  • Experience in a leadership role in software development projects;
  • Experience in delivering software projects, management, building and staffing of software development teams;
  • Manage customer expectations while working with cross-functional teams to meet customer/product delivery goals;
  • Knowledge and experience in agile methodologies;
  • Drive team to innovate and deliver roadmap features with agility and high quality;
  • Hands on profile, actively involved in technical and architectural discussions.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Cargo: Tech Lead Java

  • Definir tecnologias e arquiteturas do projeto, antecipar riscos e solucionar problemas técnicos.
  • Apoiar o PO e o time técnico durante o refinamento e o planejamento das tarefas.
  • Organizar o time de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para a definição das atividades e o planejamento das entregas.
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções voltadas para projetos de modernização.
  • Participar ativamente com o squad no entendimento de problemas e na proposição de soluções.
  • Participar de todos os ritos ágeis.
  • Garantir a qualidade e a cobertura do código de acordo com as diretrizes técnicas do banco.
  • Compreender a arquitetura dos sistemas, nuvem e processos de TI do banco Next.

  • Experiência com Java e Angular.
  • Conhecimento em Azure.
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços e monolitos.
  • Bancos de dados (SQL, views e procedures).
  • Ferramentas de CI/CD (Git, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Jira e Confluence).
  • Desenho de soluções (diagramas de sequência e classes).

  • Desenvolvimento com chamadas REST e JSON.

Habilidades Comportamentais:

Proatividade, empatia, boa comunicação, confiabilidade e flexibilidade.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Azure Cloud Application Developer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contract: CLT role


We are looking for an experienced Azure Cloud Application Developer to design, build, and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in modern architectures, enjoys working with Java/Spring Boot, and has hands-on experience with AKS and CI/CD environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Java applications using Spring Boot.
  • Architect and deploy cloud-native solutions on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Use Flyway for database versioning and migration management.
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, QA, and Data teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Monitor and optimize applications using Splunk and New Relic.
  • Participate in design reviews and architectural decisions.
  • Support analytics and BI initiatives through high-quality data solutions.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Microsoft Azure, especially Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  • Strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Data JPA
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Hands-on experience with Flyway for database migrations
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in agile development environments
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture
  • Familiarity with cloud cost optimization
  • Performance tuning experience

title: Assistente de suporte de TI
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.

Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Atender chamadas direcionadas a área de TI e Telecom garantindo a utilização dos recursos de informática e comunicação de maneira eficiente.
  • Realizar cópia de segurança de dados corporativos, restaurar arquivos corrompidos, deletados ou editados indevidamente.
  • Preparar computadores para utilização de forma segura.
  • Verificar necessidade de manutenção a fim de garantir o funcionamento adequado das máquinas e disponibilizar os mesmos para utilização.
  • Identificar problemas em rede de comunicação e planejar melhorias de procedimentos, buscando oferecer formas mais recentes de serviços e tecnologias.
  • Demais atividades conforme solicitação da gestão superior.

Instrução:

  • Ensino Técnico ou Superior em Tecnologia da Informação

Diferencial:

  • Vivencia de Atendimento em Primeiro Nível
  • Experiencia em Formatação de Maquinas
  • Conhecimento de Básicos de Rede



Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Coordenador de Banco de Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área:

  • Lidar com diversos fornecedores de produtos e serviços que atendem a disciplina de Banco de Dados acompanhando, gerindo e cobrando ações quando necessário.
  • Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados.

title: Especialista de Facilities
description:
Sobre a empresa:

  • Grande empresa com 200 anos de experiência na indústria de bebidas alcoólicas.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Coordenar as operações de Facilities das três lojas da marca;
  • Acompanhar e supervisionar atividades de manutenção predial e corretiva;
  • Realizar contato com fornecedores e negociar contratos e serviços;
  • Apoiar nas rotinas de compras e controle financeiro de insumos e materiais;
  • Acompanhar obras e reformas, garantindo prazos e qualidade na execução;
  • Gerir equipe das lojas, incluindo controle de ponto e suporte aos gerentes;
  • Prestar suporte as lojas localizadas na Oscar Freire, Itaim Bibi e Moema.


Habilidades desejadas:

  • Proatividade e dinamismo;
  • Boa capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil prático e resolutivo;
  • Organização e senso de prioridade;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Médio completo (desejável Ensino Superior);
  • Conhecimento em manutenção predial e noções de obras;
  • Experiência com compras e rotinas administrativas/financeiras;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office;
  • Vivência em negociação com fornecedores;
  • Diferencial: possuir moto para deslocamento entre as lojas.


Observações:

  • Atuação presencial nas unidades localizadas na Oscar Freire, Itaim Bibi e Moema.
  • Horário: Segunda a sexta, das 08h às 17h

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Skill/Qualifications

Experience with SAP S/4 development with Fiori application/UI5

Experience with Event-based technologies

Proficiency in SAP S/4 ABAP, SAPUI5, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, JSON

Understanding of event-based architecture utilizing publisher and consumer concept. Experience with tools such as Kafka, SAP Mesh

Experience with responsive design and performance optimization

Deep understanding of O-Data services and its enhancement, CICD pipeline using GitHub or other tools

Familiarity with SAP Web IDE or SAP Business Application Studio


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

Availability to relocate to Mexico after 3 months and remain there for the duration of the contract


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

title: Video Editor & Creative Producer
description:
About the Role

Flex AI is looking for a highly creative, fast, and detail-oriented Video Editor & Creative Producer to help us produce engaging short-form content for TikTok, Instagram, and other social platforms.

You’ll work with raw UGC (user-generated style content), creator footage, and internal material to produce fun, compelling, scroll-stopping short-form videos that fit the modern TikTok/IG aesthetic.

This is a hands-on creative role focused on fast iteration, great storytelling, and a strong understanding of platform-native video styles.


⭐ Responsibilities

  • Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Reels, and social platforms
  • Add captions, text overlays, dynamic pacing, and platform-native styling
  • Produce multiple variations of each concept
  • Work with raw UGC footage from creators
  • Collaborate with the team to execute creative ideas
  • Organize files, maintain version control, and meet weekly output targets
  • Stay on top of current TikTok trends, formats, and editing styles


⭐ Requirements

  • Proven experience editing TikTok/Reels-style short-form content
  • Strong proficiency in CapCut, Final Cut, Premiere, or similar
  • Good sense of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and visual rhythm
  • Ability to produce content quickly and consistently
  • Portfolio of UGC-style or TikTok-style videos required
  • Creative thinker with strong attention to detail
  • Organized, self-directed, and comfortable with fast iteration
  • 1–3 years editing short-form TikTok/UGC-style content
  • Fast, iterative editing style


⭐ Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with creators/influencers
  • Understanding of fitness/wellness content
  • Motion graphics or text animation skills
  • Basic understanding of social performance metrics


⭐ What We Offer

  • Fully remote, flexible working environment
  • High-ownership creative role
  • Opportunity to work on a fast-growing consumer product
  • Consistent creative work with lots of room for experimentation
  • Competitive compensation based on experience

title: Senior Full Stack Javascript Developer
description:
About HotMic


HotMic builds AI-powered video creation workflows that help creators and media teams produce high-quality content faster and more efficiently. We operate our own platform and also work closely with large enterprise customers to deliver custom, high-impact solutions.


Role Overview


We are hiring a Senior Full Stack Javascript Developer to work directly with one major enterprise customer. This is a hands-on role involving both full-stack JavaScript development and customer-facing support. You will gather requirements, develop and ship customer-specific features, resolve issues, and keep the customer updated through calls and messages. You’ll also participate in our regular engineering sprints alongside other developers and product staff.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and deliver features tailored to a large enterprise customer.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Communicate directly with the customer via calls and messages.
  • Work within engineering sprints and coordinate with internal teams.
  • Maintain clear, fluent English communication.


Requirements


  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Senior-level full-stack JavaScript experience.
  • Experience working in structured team sprints.
  • Background working with enterprise customers or complex implementations.
  • Comfortable in a mixed engineering + support role.
  • Strong teamwork and ability to work independently.

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.



As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and packag

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Copywriter Sênior
description:
A Be Neo é uma marca que funciona nos EUA e que une ciência, performance e branding para transformar a longevidade em um estilo de vida. Nascemos na intersecção entre telemedicina, tecnologia e nutrição de alta performance e nossa missão é elevar o padrão de comunicação em saúde, tornando-a inspiradora. Aqui, copy não é só texto, é estratégia, é persuasão com propósito, é o que conecta pessoas a um futuro mais saudável. 


Sua missão como Copywriter será ser o arquiteto das palavras que constroem a voz da Be Neo. Transformar complexidade médica em histórias que vendem, emocionam e constroem confiança. Você vai liderar a frente criativa de comunicação e performance, com liberdade para testar, propor e criar narrativas que movem o funil de ponta a ponta. 


Buscamos um profissional sênior com visão estratégica , maturidade criativa e domínio absoluto de performance . Alguém que já passou pela fase da pura execução, sabe o que é CAC, LTV, CTR e CPM, mas também entende de alma, timing e branding. Buscamos alguém que viva copywriting como ofício, não como ocupação. Queremos um cérebro criativo com espírito de growth hacker e coração de storyteller . 


Requisitos indispensáveis:

• 3 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada em copywriting de performance, atuando com funis diretos de venda (VSLs, advertoriais, quizzes e upsells);

• Histórico em marcas DTC brasileiras ou telehealth (Dr. Nature, Blivo, VitaScience, Manual, Omens, Bluee, etc.);

• Vivência com operações de tráfego direto, nutracêuticos, times médicos, influenciadores e campanhas multicanal (Meta, Google, TikTok, Native, YouTube);

• Inglês avançado, com capacidade de leitura e comunicação em ambiente profissional internacional.


Skills que procuramos:

• Domínio das estruturas de VSL, advertorial, quiz e upsell, com foco em baixo CAC e alto LTV;

• Capacidade de escrever para múltiplos canais e contextos como Meta Ads, Google, TikTok, Native, Email, SMS, YouTube, Amazon;

• Conhecimento das guidelines de 10DLC, FTC e restrições médicas;

• Leitura e adaptação de dados de performance para otimizar mensagens e headlines com base em resultados reais;

• Capacidade de defender suas ideias com lógica e embasamento, não apenas instinto.


Diferenciais que nos conectam:

• Já ter sido referência de copy em marcas de alta performance ou telehealth;

• Ter vivido o ciclo completo: concepção → lançamento → escala;

• Experiência real com múltiplos canais de tráfego (Meta, TikTok, Native, Google, YouTube);

• Experiência em projetos com médicos, especialistas ou influenciadores de saúde;

• Participação da estruturação de times criativos ou projetos do zero;

• Sede por testar, aprender e evoluir, sendo o tipo de pessoa que se anima com cada CTR que melhora;

• Mentalidade estrategista, não apenas de executor;

• Habilidades de comunicação e argumentação claras;

• Capacidade de colaborar com times diversos, unindo curiosidade, foco em resultados e disposição genuína para evolução pessoal/profissional.


Trabalhar na Be Neo é entrar em um movimento que está mudando o jogo.

Aqui, você participa da expansão de uma marca que une propósito, performance e inteligência, atuando lado a lado com líderes que realmente dominam growth e criatividade. E o melhor: você terá espaço real para deixar sua marca, com liberdade, responsabilidade e visibilidade.


• Formato 100% remoto , com rotina flexível organizada por sprints e entregas semanais;

• Contratação: PJ;

• Remuneração compatível com o nível sênior e performance apresentada.


Se você domina narrativa e acredita em um futuro onde saúde, inovação e cuidado humano caminham juntos, essa oportunidade pode ser pra você!

title: 饲料酶海外销售经理
description:
Key Responsibilities：

  • Comply and implement the company's processes and systems.
  • Sales Plan Execution: Execute the business strategy and annual plan developed by the department, focus on business opportunities and organize resources to achieve annual sales budget and profit budget.
  • Market development: according to the department's business development strategy and sales objectives, cooperate with relevant departments to organize and implement the regional market development plan and specific implementation plan, and promote the promotion of the company and product brand. Understand the dynamics of customer needs, tap potential customers, and track customer development to achieve continuous growth in the company's market share.
  • Customer relationship maintenance: according to the needs of the department's business development, establish smooth customer communication channels by organizing and arranging customers to visit the company, visiting and communicating. Responsible for visiting important customers in the region, keep abreast of customer requirements, handle customer objections and complaints in a timely manner to improve customer satisfaction and establish long-term, good and stable customer relationships.
  • Customer service: According to the company's customer service regulations and product characteristics, through communication with technical support, research and development, production and other relevant departments, coordinate product trial, technical support and other work to improve customer satisfaction with products and company services.
  • Sales expense control: comply with the company's sales expense management regulations and the sales department's expense budget indicators to control sales expenses.
  • Collaborative communication: Establish necessary cross-departmental business contacts and communication to ensure timely information sharing and delivery.
  • Others: Complete temporary important tasks assigned by superiors.

Qualifications：

  • At least BSc. in Biochemical or Bioengineering or any relevant fields with minimum 5 years working experience in enzyme industry.
  • Master the basic knowledge of all products and services of the company and understand the company's operation mode.
  • Good sales etiquette, able to better grasp the customer's psychology, understand and can effectively use sales skills.
  • Able to think from the customer's point of view, strong sales ability.
  • Good communication and coordination skills, calm, initiative and responsible.
  • High work enthusiasm, good team work spirit.
  • Strong ability to resist pressure and learning ability

title: Desenvolvedor Mobile
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor Mobile (Flutter)

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Mobile com experiência sólida em Flutter e integração com Android nativo , para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de nossas aplicações.


Requisitos Técnicos

Linguagens/Frameworks

  • Domínio em Flutter (Dart);
  • Forte conhecimento em Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO);
  • Experiência com GetX (state management, rotas, injeção de dependência);
  • Experiência com MethodChannel para comunicação Flutter ↔ Android nativo;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Android Nativo (Java e/ou Kotlin);

Ferramentas

  • Experiência com VS Code;
  • Conhecimentos em Android Studio (build, emuladores, debugging nativo);
  • Uso de Git (Azure DevOps ou GitHub);

Plataforma/Arquitetura

  • Experiência com ciclo de vida de aplicações Flutter;
  • Estruturação modular de projetos;
  • Consumo de APIs REST;
  • Manipulação de armazenamento local (SharedPreferences, SQLite);
  • Integração com bibliotecas nativas Android via Gradle;
  • Criação e manutenção de bridges Flutter ↔ Android.

Qualidade/Performance

  • Familiaridade com testes unitários em Flutter;
  • Boas práticas de otimização de performance;
  • Tratamento de exceções e logs.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • Conhecimento em C# ou Node.js;
  • Experiência com integrações de pagamento, TEF, SmartPOS ou automação comercial;
  • Vivência com POS Android (Gertec, PAX, Sunmi, Stone, Cielo);
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions);
  • Boas práticas de segurança mobile;
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas limpas (Clean Architecture, SOLID);
  • Experiência com criação e manutenção de plugins Flutter.


Benefícios

  • Horário flexível;
  • Banco de horas;
  • Auxílio home office;

title: Sr SAP F2F (MES, PPDS, QM) – Advanced English
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Responsibilities

Configure and support SAP PPDS for optimized production planning.

Collaborate with manufacturing teams to improve supply chain efficiency.

Translate business requirements into SAP functional specifications.

Perform unit testing, integration testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

Ensure compliance with IT change management standards (ITIL), including documentation and user training.


Required Skills & Qualifications

Knowledge of PPDS, Digital Manufacturing and Quality Management design and configuration in SAP.

Knowledge of SAP MM/PP design and configuration.

Experience leading teams of analysts and directing work of others .

Understanding of integration points between PPDS, Digital Manufacturing and Quality modules of SAP.

Experience leading complex projects and coordinating work amongst a cross-functional team.


Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of production Planning configuration in SAP S/4 Fiori Environment

Experience in a hands-on technical role such as technical project management, systems development, or similar roles.

2+ years of experience serving as a subject matter expert in a capacity that is relevant to the area this role will focus/support

Ability to assist with the implementation of project and systems delivery methodologies.

Demonstrated flexibility in adapting to changing end-user business needs.


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Additional Requirement:

Availability to relocate to Mexico after 3 months and remain there for the duration of the contract


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect



Equality & Opportunity for All

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
Operations Coordinator

Duration : 12 month contract to hire

Location : 100% remote

Pay : $10-15/hour USD (depending on experience)


Our client is looking for a highly organized and proactive Resource Operations Coordinator to join their team remotely. You’ll be the go-to person for operational support, onboarding, invoice reconciliation, and stakeholder coordination, with light resource management responsibilities. This is a role that requires strong multitasking skills, attention to detail, and the ability to build relationships across multiple teams.

Delivery & Operations

  • Manage onboarding for new hires and contractors.
  • Handle invoice reconciliation, timesheet tracking, and cross-referencing rates.
  • Support Talent Acquisition and recruitment coordination.
  • Maintain operational workflows and ensure compliance with internal processes.
  • Prepare and update reports using Excel and PowerBI dashboards.

Engineering Support

  • Assist engineering leadership with HR/admin tasks.
  • Coordinate resource-related activities when needed.
  • Act as a liaison between delivery and engineering teams for smooth communication.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal teams and external partners.
  • Build strong relationships with pod leads, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Facilitate communication and ensure alignment across multiple teams.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5–7 years of experience in operations, HR coordination, or similar roles.
  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills; ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Proficiency in Excel, Word, and familiarity with PowerBI dashboards.
  • Experience with invoice reconciliation, timesheets, and financial cross-checking.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to build relationships across teams.
  • Proactive, reliable, and detail-oriented with a willingness to adapt and learn.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Senior (Node/React)
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções com Inteligencia Artificial (B2C) contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.


Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração: Dólar | Full-time | Range: 5.2K a 6.2K


O que você fará:


● Colaborar diretamente com os fundadores e equipe para projetar, construir e lançar funcionalidades alimentadas por IA de ponta a ponta

● Usar ferramentas e agentes de IA diariamente para acelerar desenvolvimento, experimentação e polimento do produto

● Ser responsável pelo desenvolvimento fullstack do produto: do design do schema do banco de dados e APIs backend à criação de interfaces performáticas

● Construir sistemas orientados a eventos (jobs assíncronos, filas, notificações)

● Integrar LLMs por meio de um API wrapper centralizado, lidando com engenharia de prompt, lógica de orquestração e vetorização

● Escrever código testado, de qualidade, preparado para manutenção

● Ajudar a moldar a cultura do time de engenharia desde o primeiro dia, influenciando padrões de qualidade e formas de colaboração


Requisitos:


● Sólida mentalidade AI-native , utilizando ferramentas e agentes de IA como parte do fluxo diário de desenvolvimento

● Forte orientação a produto , com habilidade para construir interfaces e experiências de consumo

● Experiência fullstack , incluindo atuação com infraestrutura gerenciada (Vercel, AWS), bancos de dados, backend e frontend

● Domínio de TypeScript, React, Next.js, Postgres e arquiteturas serverless

● Escrever código de produção de alta qualidade

● Excelentes habilidades de colaboração, com experiência trabalhando próximo a fundadores, produto e design em ambientes rápidos e de estágio inicial

● Experiencias anteriores desenvolvendo produtos consumer-facing incluindo ambiente fullstack com TypeScript

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (C#/.NET/React.js)
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js (preferred), Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.

You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution enhances brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations to result in lower costs, and boosts sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations utilize their technology today, processing more than $5 billion in payments annually.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform full life-cycle commercial software development and maintenance, including analyzing specifications, documenting requirements, and architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions
  • Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance
  • Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too
  • Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies
  • Analyze code to identify defect root causes and provide resolutions
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Perform high-quality peer reviews


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience, preferably React.js (Vue.js, OR Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have "ownership mindset" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks


Desired Experience (Not Required)

  • Daily use of Docker/containers (you wrote the Dockerfile)
  • Azure PaaS (Container Apps, SQL, Cosmos DB, etc.)
  • Track record of expanding scope of responsibility over time (e.g., owning more complex features, introducing new tooling)
  • Obsession with metrics, logging, and user impact


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Consultor de Atendimento Comercial
description:
Consultor de Atendimento Comercial – Clínica Dr. Rafael Hamada


Local: Osvaldo Cruz/SP - Presencial

Tipo de Contratação: Tempo Integral (PJ)


Sobre nós


Somos uma clínica de excelência, especializada em Medicina Regenerativa, Medicina da Dor e Ortopedia.


Acreditamos que o atendimento começa muito antes da consulta, começa no primeiro contato. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) de Atendimento Comercial com perfil analítico, humano e orientado a resultados, para integrar o time responsável por acolher, orientar e converter novos pacientes.


Responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo do paciente, desde o primeiro contato (triagem/agendamento) até a realização da consulta, assegurando uma alta taxa de conversão e retenção;
  • Estruturar, monitorar e analisar indicadores (KPIs) como volume de agendamentos, comparecimento, conversão em consultas e taxa de recompra;
  • Implementar e operar sistemas de CRM adequados à gestão da clínica (ex.: Kommo, ou similares);
  • Criar e executar estratégias de follow-up (ligações, WhatsApp, e-mails e mensagens automatizadas) em parceria com o time de marketing e comunicação;
  • Integrar-se às equipes de atendimento e coordenação clínica, garantindo alinhamento entre demanda e disponibilidade dos profissionais;
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentar resultados à direção, sugerindo planos de ação e melhorias contínuas;


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Experiência comprovada como SDR, pré-vendas ou atendimento comercial, preferencialmente no setor da saúde;
  • Histórico consistente de metas alcançadas ou superadas;
  • Conhecimento sólido em CRM e gestão de pipeline de pacientes/clientes;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de construir rapport rapidamente;
  • Perfil analítico, com habilidade para interpretar métricas e tomar decisões baseadas em dados;
  • Desejável: Formação em Administração, Marketing, Gestão de Saúde ou áreas correlatas;


Por que se juntar a nós?


  • Oportunidade de crescimento junto a uma clínica em expansão;
  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Ambiente profissional e acolhedor, com aprendizado constante e feedback contínuo;
  • Cultura data-driven e humanizada, que combina métricas de alta performance com empatia e propósito.


Na Clínica do Dr. Rafael, cada ligação e cada conversa podem transformar uma vida.


Buscamos profissionais movidos por resultados, mas também tocados pelo propósito de cuidar de pessoas.

Aplicação pelo LinkedIn e forms.

Entrevista on-line com RH

Case prático de estratégia de conversão de leads.

Proposta final.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: SAP Fiori Developer
description:
SAP Fiori Developer


  • Duração da atribuição: Indefinida
  • Contrato de Trabalho: PJ ou via Cooperativa
  • Local de trabalho: 100% remoto
  • Horário: 9h00 – 18h00 (Fuso horário dos EUA)
  • Taxa hora: A ser negociado


Descrição da vaga:


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior SAP UI5 / Fiori / OData altamente experiente, com histórico comprovado no design e implementação de soluções corporativas utilizando SAP NetWeaver e tecnologias modernas de interface Web.


O candidato ideal deve trazer forte expertise técnica, criatividade em design UX/UI e experiência prática no desenvolvimento de aplicações SAP escaláveis e sustentáveis em ambientes S/4HANA e BTP.


Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e aprimorar aplicações SAP Fiori e UI5 alinhadas às diretrizes de design UX da SAP e aos padrões corporativos.
  • Construir serviços OData baseados em CDS e implementar operações completas CRUD.
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações front-end de alta qualidade utilizando SAP Web IDE, Business Application Studio (BAS), HTML5, CSS, JavaScript e XML.
  • Trabalhar extensivamente com SAP NetWeaver Gateway e serviços OData para integração entre sistemas front-end e back-end.
  • Aprimorar e customizar aplicações Fiori padrão e implementar controles reutilizáveis UI5 e Fiori Elements.
  • Utilizar SAP Theme Designer para personalizar e alinhar a interface com a identidade visual corporativa.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais e técnicas para garantir entregas de alta qualidade e experiência do usuário otimizada.
  • Aplicar habilidades avançadas de depuração tanto na camada UI5 quanto na camada ABAP para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente.
  • Participar de discussões sobre design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de otimização de performance.


Requisitos:


  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado (Mandatório, pois deverão estar aptos a se comunicarem fluentemente)
  • Experiência profissional em desenvolvimento SAP, sendo dedicados a SAP UI5 / Fiori / OData.
  • Expertise em SAP UI5, Fiori Elements, CDS Views, OData Services, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript e XML.
  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Web IDE, SAP Business Application Studio (BAS) e Eclipse IDE para desenvolvimento SAP.
  • Sólido entendimento de SAP S/4HANA, arquitetura NetWeaver e ambiente de desenvolvimento SAP BTP.
  • Experiência com UI Theme Designer, padrões de design Fiori e melhores práticas modernas de UX/UI.
  • Habilidade em depuração utilizando SAP UI5 Inspector, Chrome Developer Tools e ABAP Debugger.
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs REST e trabalho com estruturas de dados JSON/XML.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas, com habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente ou liderar equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração em ambientes globais e multifuncionais.


Mais informações serão fornecidas durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Role: Ruby on Rails Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 9+ months (extendable)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


What You Will Do

  • Deliver engaging, robust solutions that effectively solve business problems.
  • Leverage your deep experience in Ruby on Rails to ensure scalable architecture and web application development that supports continued growth.
  • Collaborate with the team in coding, brainstorming, and scoping sessions.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, balancing risk-taking with measurable results and short development cycles.


How You Will Make an Impact


  • Write clean, well-structured code that balances rapid delivery with sustainable, tested patterns.
  • Adapt quickly and move between projects with ease.
  • Seek to understand the “why” behind requirements and solutions.
  • Know when to use off-the-shelf technology vs. building custom solutions.
  • Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a strong initiative-driven approach.
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative, and energetic team culture.
  • Deliver quality solutions that build strong relationships with QA and other stakeholders.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in software development.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Ruby and Rails (full stack).
  • Strong expertise with Postgres and Redis.
  • Deep experience in web application development: design, architecture, configuration, performance optimization, integration, and analytics.
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Experience with Agile development practices.


Bonus Points For

  • Experience building applications with StimulusReflex and Hotwire .
  • Comfort with front-end development using JavaScript, Stimulus, View Components, and SCSS .
  • Prior experience working on internationally distributed teams.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

description:
⚠️ Full professional proficiency in English is required for this position ⚠️

⚠️ Web Design challenge is going to be required ⚠️


Who we are


Uitify is a brand and growth partner for early-stage SaaS companies. We help ambitious startups define their positioning, design their identity, and communicate with clarity and personality — across every touchpoint. We combine strategy, design, and content to build brands that are consistent, memorable, and conversion-driven.

We work fast, collaborate closely, and care deeply about doing work that’s both smart and beautiful.


Who we’re looking for


We’re looking for a Visual Designer who brings strong visual direction, consistency, and creativity. You’ll work closely with our branding, marketing, and product teams to design clean, modern, and conversion-focused assets for fast-growing SaaS companies.

This is a hands-on creative role — ideal for someone who thrives on bringing ideas to life and shaping the visual expression of digital-first brands.


What you’ll do


  • Design and deliver high-quality visual assets: landing pages, pitch decks, social media creatives, eBooks, case studies, and more
  • Ensure consistency and alignment across all brand touchpoints
  • Collaborate with strategists, copywriters, and product designers to translate ideas into strong visuals
  • Contribute to branding, product, and marketing initiatives with a focus on performance and clarity
  • Present and discuss your work with the team and, occasionally, with clients


What we’re looking for


  • A strong portfolio showcasing digital design (branding, marketing, web, presentations, etc.)
  • 5+ years of experience;
  • Proficiency in Webflow, Figma or Framer, figma/canva/photoshop are differentials;
  • A sharp eye for layout, typography, hierarchy, and color
  • Experience designing for SaaS or B2B tech products
  • Ability to handle multiple projects with clarity, speed, and organization
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail


Bonus points


  • Experience working with SaaS companies or startups
  • Experience with People Analytics or B.I.
  • Basic knowledge of UX principles and how design influences user behavior
  • Motion design or video editing skills
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently
  • A proactive, collaborative mindset and a passion for visual storytelling


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Senior
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Estamos construindo a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas.

Por isso, buscamos um Super Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Senior , dinâmico e experiente, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Tecnologia e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Irá ajudar a criar e implementar soluções para manter o sistema sempre prático e escalável;
  • Fazer code reviews com atenção e cuidado;
  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar aplicações backend usando Node.js, TypeScript e JavaScript;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para projetar e implementar soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho;
  • Integrar sistemas com serviços de nuvem (ex: Firebase, AWS) para garantir escalabilidade e confiabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e manter bancos de dados MongoDB, garantindo eficiência e segurança;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de DevOps, automatizando processos e implantando pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Colaborar com outros membros da equipe para garantir a consistência e a qualidade do código;
  • Responder prontamente às necessidades da equipe e do projeto, resolvendo problemas com princípios de programação sólidos.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Node.js;
  • Conhecimento de TypeScript e JavaScript.
  • Experiência em integração com serviços de nuvem (Firebase, AWS, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Postgres e Mongodb;
  • Saiba escrever testes;
  • Experiência em práticas de DevOps;
  • Compreensão profunda de arquitetura de software orientada a serviços e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Alguma experiência com desenho, construção e otimização de arquitetura serverless;
  • Experiência com Clean Code e/ou Clean Architecture;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com problemas novos e difíceis e de contribuir para bibliotecas conforme necessário.


Será legal se você tiver:

  • Experiência como Tech Lead;
  • Experiência com CI/CD com pipelines;
  • Conhecimento de métodos ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Prática com ferramentas de versionamento como o GIT.


Como é a Cultura Super?

Temos uma cultura de muita confiança, focada em resultados, sem micro gerenciamento, muita autonomia e transparência. Muitos desafios e aprendizados, buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo.


O que oferecemos:

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
  • ⚕Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
  • ♀️Wellhub/GymPass: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
  • Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Position Summary:


Our partner, a growing streaming and marketing optimization product company, is looking to add a BI Analyst to its team. In this role, your focus will be on analyzing operational business data and transforming it into meaningful insights and actionable strategies. You will collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, extract and analyze data from various platforms, and create actionable reports. You will play a key role in providing valuable insights and supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization. Therefore, the ideal candidate should have a strong analytical mindset, excellent data manipulation skills, and a passion for transforming data into actionable business intelligence.


Experience and Education:


  • Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related technical field/experience.
  • 3+ years of experience as a BI Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Experienced in SQL and advanced SQL queries, to extract and manipulate data.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and how to design effective data structures for reporting and analysis.


Skills and Strengths:


  • SQL Queries
  • MySQL
  • SQL Server
  • PostgreSQL
  • Power BI
  • Tableau
  • BI Analysis
  • Data Visualization & Reporting (Google Looker Preferred)
  • Business Presentations
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication
  • Python (a plus)


Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Collect and extract data from SQL databases using advanced queries and data modeling.
  • Utilize data analysis techniques to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights from complex datasets.
  • Develop reports to provide valuable insights to stakeholders that will support data-driven decision-making.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand and identify business needs and document reporting requirements.
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools to anticipate future trends and outcomes, helping in strategic planning.
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting by validating data integrity.
  • Maintain documentation of reports, queries, and data processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data-related processes, data quality, and reporting efficiency, resolving data discrepancies or inconsistencies.
  • Stay updated with the latest BI trends, tools, and technologies, incorporating best practices into work, to improve reporting capabilities.
