title: Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce)
description:
We are looking for a Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce) who will be responsible for developing complex business needs and providing technical solutions for our Salesforce ecosystem. This person should be flexible to adopt or learn new tools to map the growing business processes as the need arises. This role will report into IT Business Systems team. This role will help positively impact our commercial sales, marketing, agronomy, finance, supply chain, IT & other key business functions with smart, forward-looking solutions and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer, design, develop & support Salesforce Platform (Sales, Service, Marketing/Pardot, Experience Cloud)
  • Take ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code.
  • Develop Apex (classes and triggers), experience building Custom User Interface, including Visualforce pages/Lightning pages, Aura Components and Lightning Web Components.
  • Design and develop sites using Experience Site Builder and customization of experience site interface.
  • Design and develop custom workflows, approval flows as fits the business needs and prepare solution design documents, data flow diagrams, test cases etc. as needed.
  • Adhere to Salesforce best practices, maintain code documentation, and write / maintain test classes for all custom development.
  • Work directly with business (Commercial Sales & Marketing, Agronomy) understanding the business requirements & provide timely and apt solutions.
  • Closely work with extended IT team developers to design, develop, test, implement & support system solutions primarily in Salesforce Platform.


Qualifications and Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on development & design experience with Salesforce Platform is a MUST
  • Experience implementing and developing in Apex, LWC/Aura/Visualforce is a MUST
  • General web development experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript is a MUST
  • Experience working with large data sets, Salesforce API’s and bulkification is a MUST
  • Excellent analytical and debugging skills is a MUST
  • Knowledge of IT SDLC and SOX methodologies is MUST
  • Experience with mobile publisher, Salesforce maps are a big plus
  • Experience with ERP, Datawarehouse, BI/Tableau tools are a big plus
  • Ability to work as part of IT team with clear verbal and written communication
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, and Information Systems is preferred

  • Experience implementing and developing in Apex, LWC/Aura/Visualforce is a MUST
  • General web development experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript is a MUST
  • Experience working with large data sets, Salesforce API’s and bulkification is a MUST
  • Excellent analytical and debugging skills is a MUST
  • Knowledge of IT SDLC and SOX methodologies is MUST
  • Experience with mobile publisher, Salesforce maps are a big plus
  • Experience with ERP, Datawarehouse, BI/Tableau tools are a big plus
  • Ability to work as part of IT team with clear verbal and written communication

title: SDR| Vendedor - Prospecção Qualificada
description:
SDR – Especialista em Prospecção de Novos Negócios


Somos um escritório especializado em recuperação tributária e soluções tributárias e jurídicas para médias e grandes empresas. Com mais de 16 anos de experiência consolidada no mercado, estamos em plena fase de expansão e buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto conosco.


Local de trabalho: Zona Leste de São Paulo em prédio próprio, próximo à estação Belém (linha vermelha do metrô)

Área: Comercial / Desenvolvimento de Negócios


Se você é competitivo, comunicativo e movido por metas , essa vaga é para você. Buscamos um SDR/BDR atuando como Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) , com foco em prospecção e qualificação de novos negócios .

O profissional será responsável por identificar empresas com potencial , iniciar o contato comercial , gerar interesse e conduzir leads até o momento do agendamento da reunião com o time de executivos de vendas.

Trabalhamos com soluções jurídicas e tributárias empresariais , em um ambiente dinâmico, com alta demanda e espaço para crescimento profissional e financeiro baseado em performance.


Principais atividades:


  • Mapear empresas e identificar oportunidades comerciais no mercado B2B;
  • Realizar prospecção ativa (outbound) via e-mail, telefone, LinkedIn e WhatsApp;
  • Fazer o primeiro contato com decisores , apresentando de forma consultiva os diferenciais da empresa;
  • Qualificar leads conforme critérios definidos e registrar todas as interações no CRM;
  • Agendar reuniões comerciais com o time de Closer ou Consultores Tributários;
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos leads no funil e contribuir para estratégias de conversão;
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e aprimoramento das técnicas de prospecção.


Requisitos

  • Experiência anterior em prospecção B2B, SDR, BDR ou Inside Sales ;
  • Perfil disciplinado, persuasivo e orientado a resultados ;
  • Capacidade de lidar com alto volume de contatos e metas semanais;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com postura profissional e argumentação técnica;
  • Disponibilidade para prestação de serviços PJ , com foco em entregas e metas.


Diferenciais que valorizamos


  • Experiência no setor jurídico, tributário, contábil ou financeiro ;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, RD Station) ;
  • Domínio de metodologias como SPIN Selling , Outbound 2.0 e funil de prospecção B2B ;
  • Histórico de alta produtividade e alcance de metas comerciais .

Remuneração e Regime


  • Regime de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ);
  • Remuneração variável baseada em performance (comissão por lead qualificado e reunião gerada);
  • Ganhos escaláveis de acordo com o volume e qualidade de entregas.


Buscamos alguém com espírito de vendedor nato , com sede por crescimento e ganhos proporcionais ao desempenho.

Um profissional focado, confiante e proativo , que compreende o valor da disciplina e da constância no processo comercial.

  • Aqui, você não será apenas mais um vendedor, será o motor que impulsiona novos negócios

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Procuramos um(a) Cloud Operations Engineer Pleno (AWS) para compor nosso time de Cloud e Operações. Esse profissional será peça-chave na sustentação, automação e evolução da nossa infraestrutura em nuvem, garantindo ambientes performáticos, seguros e altamente disponíveis para suportar a escalabilidade de nossos produtos SaaS.


MISSÃO:

Como parte da estrutura de engenharia de Cloud e SRE, sua missão será garantir a operação eficiente de nossos ambientes em nuvem, atuando com foco em automação, performance e confiabilidade. Você será um dos responsáveis por desenhar, manter e evoluir a infraestrutura que sustenta nossos produtos, trabalhando lado a lado com DevOps, SREs e especialistas de segurança.

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

O Desenvolvedor Pleno é um profissional multi-skill, com olhar para o design digital e com experiência nos elementos de experiência do usuário e acessibilidade. O foco principal do trabalho será em projetos de baixa complexidade, atuando com desenvolvimento de aplicações IVA, no Veeva, programação de banners animados HTML/CSS, com o GWD e e-mails marketing , mas também incluirá edição de conteúdo de websites, uso de webapps de terceiros e estruturas de programas para o iPad. Espera-se que você forneça suporte às equipes de desenvolvimento sênior na codificação, atualize o código existente com pedidos de mudança de conteúdo e auxilie na depuração de problemas logados pelo time de QA. Haverá o uso diário de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD e Photoshop (assim como de outros programas do Adobe Creative Suite). Você deverá estar familiarizado com estes programas e se sentir confortável em usá-los para visualizar layouts e exportar imagens.


Responsabilidades:

• Domínio da plataforma Veeva para o desenvolvimento e manutenção em IVAs.

• Programação de banners e emails (formatos iniciais e ajustes de materiais já existentes);

• Elaboração de screenshots (para os quais terá um treinamento por parte da empresa);

• Entendimento dos pedidos e instruções em inglês nos documentos marcados e implementar as mudanças solicitadas;

• Participar de scrums internos e/ou planejamento de projetos;

• Traduzir projetos criativos para um código limpo e livre de erros que se alinhe às melhores práticas do Studio Rx;

• Assegurar que os pedidos de trabalho sejam concluídos com qualidade e no tempo estabelecido;

• Obter e manter as certificações exigidas, conforme identificadas pela equipe de Operações.


Requerimentos & Skills:

• Bacharelado em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• 4-6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento com proficiência em desenvolvimento web de front-end (padrões web HTML5);

• Certificação Veeva para desenvolvimento de IVAs;

• Experiência com animações CSS, transições e uso de key frame;

• Experiência com estruturas Javascript ou JS (Jquery, Angular, Node);

• Experiência com Git, Azure, SVN, ou sistemas de controle de versões similares;

• Uso do Adobe Creative Suite (Figma, XD e Photoshop);

• Familiaridade com HTML 5 e Web Standards, SEO, Acessibilidade, desenvolvimento de e-mails visando à compatibilidade cross-browser/cross-platform, javascript e algum framework (React, Angular, Vue, Next);

• Uso de ferramentas para emular dispositivos móveis e sistemas operacionais (BrowserStack, E-mail on Acid);

• Familiarizado com dispositivos tablet (Android, iPad) e smartphones;

• Inglês Avançado (foco em leitura, interpretação de texto e escrita).


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Core Sênior


Descrição da Vaga


Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend .NET Core , para atuar em projetos de arquitetura moderna, utilizando microsserviços , mensageria e entrega contínua . A pessoa será responsável por desenvolver, testar e evoluir APIs escaláveis e performáticas, aplicando boas práticas de Clean Code , DDD (Domain Driven Design) e desenvolvimento orientado a objetos .

O ambiente de trabalho adota metodologias ágeis , com forte colaboração entre times multidisciplinares, e foco em qualidade, automação e melhoria contínua .


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e microsserviços utilizando .NET Core (.NET 8) ;
  • Aplicar princípios de DDD , orientação a objetos e Clean Code ;
  • Implementar soluções com mediator pattern , mensageria e comunicação assíncrona ;
  • Trabalhar com ORMs (Entity Framework, Dapper) para integração com bancos SQL e NoSQL ;
  • Criar e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração);
  • Contribuir para pipeline de entrega contínua (CI/CD) e práticas de feature toggle ;
  • Colaborar com times ágeis em um ambiente Kanban/Scrum ;
  • Participar de revisões de código e discussões de arquitetura;
  • Apoiar a evolução das práticas de engenharia e qualidade de software.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência com .NET Core (preferencialmente .NET 8 );
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e testes de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sólido em orientação a objetos e DDD ;
  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e microsserviços ;
  • Experiência com mensageria e comunicação assíncrona ;
  • Experiência com bancos SQL (e desejável NoSQL);
  • Experiência com ORMs (Entity Framework e/ou Dapper);
  • Experiência com Mediator Pattern ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e desenvolvimento com containers;
  • Experiência com entrega contínua (CI/CD) e feature toggle ;
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e colaboração com múltiplos times.


Desejável

  • Conhecimento em TDD e BDD ;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes ;
  • Experiência com Microsoft Azure ;
  • Familiaridade com Kanban ;
  • Interesse em práticas de DevOps e automação de deploy.

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

O Desenvolvedor Pleno é um profissional multi-skill, com olhar para o design digital e com experiência nos elementos de experiência do usuário e acessibilidade. O foco principal do trabalho será em projetos de baixa complexidade, atuando com desenvolvimento de aplicações IVA, no Veeva, programação de banners animados HTML/CSS, com o GWD e e-mails marketing , mas também incluirá edição de conteúdo de websites, uso de webapps de terceiros e estruturas de programas para o iPad. title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: JD Edwards (Financial Consultant)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 54563


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 6 anos atuando JAVA, com versões atuais, Springboot e Quarkus;

- Experiência em AWS ( Lambda, S3, CloudFormation, EC2, SQS e RDS);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de APIs e automações;

- Atuar profissionalmente com JavaScript e Angular 2+ para aplicações web;

- OCR para extração e leitura de informações em imagens e documentos.

- Docker para padronização e conteinerização de ambiente;

- Experiência em Grafana para monitoramento e análise de métricas;

- Experiência com Langfuse e LangChain para integração e desenvolvimento de soluções com IA generativa;

- Fundamentos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Linguagem Natural;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados (ETL, modelagem e transformação);

- Experiência com RAG.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Low-Code Mendix Sênior
description:
Estamos contratando: Desenvolvedor(a) Mendix Sênior

Quer trabalhar em projetos de alto impacto usando a plataforma low-code que mais cresce no mundo?

Somos um integrador oficial Mendix no Brasil, e buscamos alguém para criar soluções digitais inovadoras para clientes de diversos setores.


O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver aplicações ponta-a-ponta em Mendix Studio Pro.
  • Criar integrações complexas com APIs, sistemas legados e novas tecnologias.
  • Definir arquitetura e boas práticas para projetos Mendix.
  • Explorar IA e automação para soluções inteligentes.
  • Treinar e apoiar times de clientes.

✅ O que buscamos

  • 3+ anos de experiência em projetos Mendix completos.
  • Domínio de Mendix Studio Pro (UX, microflows/nanoflows, integrações, Java Actions).
  • Certificação Mendix Intermediate ou Advanced .
  • Base sólida em desenvolvimento de software (Java, JavaScript, Python, SQL).
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis .
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.
  • Desejável Integração Mendix com ERP, CRM ou IoT.
  • Desejável experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de aplicações móveis

Por que vir para cá

  • Projetos desafiadores e inovadores.
  • Certificações e treinamentos oficiais Mendix.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e oportunidade real de crescimento.

title: Murex DevOps (CEM) Consultant
description:
Project description

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities


Environment Operations Consultant:

Environment deployment and Management Operations

•Deploy and manage Murex Software needed for Murex client projects using Murex tools and scripts.

•Perform basic smoke tests before delivering the needed products.

•Act as a first-level support for already deployed Murex products, re-directing and following the issues with the corresponding support teams.

•Performing system health checks and diagnostics (RAM, CPU, processes, etc.) to ensure optimal performance and uptime

•Automating routine tasks

Conversion of a customer database

•Perform database sanitization and purging procedures

•Migration sequence execution and stabilization

Setting Methodologies and Procedures

•Contribute to creating the environment and configuration management methodologies, conversion processes, communication workflows, and needed templates and documentation

•Customize and document the installation and the conversion/upgrade procedures

•Deliver needed training and best practices for Murex Clients and project teams

•Manage internal streams: contribute to creating tools, measure related KPIs, and analyze potential issues


Collaboration

•Ensures good collaboration with the project team

•Ensures good collaboration with customer


Capitalization

•Capitalizes on issues not related to a specific client

•Contributes to product evolution (feedback to product teams, follow-up on defects and issues)

Technical Skills

•Degree in Computer Science Engineering or Information Technology Engineering (or related discipline)

•Experience with scripting languages

•Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure

•Strong communication skills

•Knowledge of technical machine specifications

•Knowledge of XML manipulations

•Knowledge of UNIX Operations with hands-on expertise in command-line operations

•Knowledge of RDMS Operations

•Understanding of the Financial markets


Skills must have:

- Strong working knowledge of Murex Configuration and Environment management

- Strong knowledge of scheduler software (e.g. Tidal, Autosys, JAMS, ...etc.)

- Good understanding of MXTest

- Good product knowledge/understanding in IRD, CRD, EQD, FXD

- Good understanding of Workflows, Operations, Fixings process, Confirmations, and Trade Life Cycle

- Strong functional and technical understanding of Murex

- Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers


Must:

- previous experience, min 2yrs, with Murex Environment management

- MXTest Module (a plus)

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Good SQL, Unix , Scripting , Sybase and Oracle skills


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Responsibilities

Environment deployment and Management Operations

•Deploy and manage Murex Software needed for Murex client projects using Murex tools and scripts.

•Automating routine tasks

Conversion of a customer database

•Perform database sanitization and purging procedures

•Migration sequence execution and stabilization

Setting Methodologies and Procedures

•Contribute to creating the environment and configuration management methodologies, conversion processes, communication workflows, and needed templates and documentation

•Customize and document the installation and the conversion/upgrade procedures

•Deliver needed training and best practices for Murex Clients and project teams

•Manage internal streams: contribute to creating tools, measure related KPIs, and analyze potential issues


Collaboration

•Ensures good collaboration with the project team

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.


Please submit resumé in English.

  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.

title: Murex DevOps (CEM) Consultant
description:
Project description

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities


Environment Operations Consultant:

Environment deployment and Management Operations

•Deploy and manage Murex Software needed for Murex client projects using Murex tools and scripts.

•Perform basic smoke tests before delivering the needed products.

•Act as a first-level support for already deployed Murex products, re-directing and following the issues with the corresponding support teams.

•Performing system health checks and diagnostics (RAM, CPU, processes, etc.) to ensure optimal performance and uptime

•Automating routine tasks

Conversion of a customer database

•Perform database sanitization and purging procedures

•Migration sequence execution and stabilization

Setting Methodologies and Procedures

•Contribute to creating the environment and configuration management methodologies, conversion processes, communication workflows, and needed templates and documentation

•Customize and document the installation and the conversion/upgrade procedures

•Deliver needed training and best practices for Murex Clients and project teams

•Manage internal streams: contribute to creating tools, measure related KPIs, and analyze potential issues


Collaboration

•Ensures good collaboration with the project team

•Ensures good collaboration with customer


Capitalization

•Capitalizes on issues not related to a specific client

•Contributes to product evolution (feedback to product teams, follow-up on defects and issues)

Technical Skills

•Degree in Computer Science Engineering or Information Technology Engineering (or related discipline)

•Experience with scripting languages

•Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure

•Strong communication skills

•Knowledge of technical machine specifications

•Knowledge of XML manipulations

•Knowledge of UNIX Operations with hands-on expertise in command-line operations

•Knowledge of RDMS Operations

•Understanding of the Financial markets


Skills must have:

- Strong working knowledge of Murex Configuration and Environment management

- Strong knowledge of scheduler software (e.g. Tidal, Autosys, JAMS, ...etc.)

- Good understanding of MXTest

- Good product knowledge/understanding in IRD, CRD, EQD, FXD

- Good understanding of Workflows, Operations, Fixings process, Confirmations, and Trade Life Cycle

- Strong functional and technical understanding of Murex

- Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers


Must:

- previous experience, min 2yrs, with Murex Environment management

- MXTest Module (a plus)

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Good SQL, Unix , Scripting , Sybase and Oracle skills


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Murex DevOps (CEM) Consultant
description:
Project description

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities


Environment Operations Consultant:

Environment deployment and Management Operations

•Deploy and manage Murex Software needed for Murex client projects using Murex tools and scripts.

•Perform basic smoke tests before delivering the needed products.

•Act as a first-level support for already deployed Murex products, re-directing and following the issues with the corresponding support teams.

•Performing system health checks and diagnostics (RAM, CPU, processes, etc.) to ensure optimal performance and uptime

•Automating routine tasks

Conversion of a customer database

•Perform database sanitization and purging procedures

•Migration sequence execution and stabilization

Setting Methodologies and Procedures

•Contribute to creating the environment and configuration management methodologies, conversion processes, communication workflows, and needed templates and documentation

•Customize and document the installation and the conversion/upgrade procedures

•Deliver needed training and best practices for Murex Clients and project teams

•Manage internal streams: contribute to creating tools, measure related KPIs, and analyze potential issues


Collaboration

•Ensures good collaboration with the project team

•Ensures good collaboration with customer


Capitalization

•Capitalizes on issues not related to a specific client

•Contributes to product evolution (feedback to product teams, follow-up on defects and issues)

Technical Skills

•Degree in Computer Science Engineering or Information Technology Engineering (or related discipline)

•Experience with scripting languages

•Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure

•Strong communication skills

•Knowledge of technical machine specifications

•Knowledge of XML manipulations

•Knowledge of UNIX Operations with hands-on expertise in command-line operations

•Knowledge of RDMS Operations

•Understanding of the Financial markets


Skills must have:

- Strong working knowledge of Murex Configuration and Environment management

- Strong knowledge of scheduler software (e.g. Tidal, Autosys, JAMS, ...etc.)

- Good understanding of MXTest

- Good product knowledge/understanding in IRD, CRD, EQD, FXD

- Good understanding of Workflows, Operations, Fixings process, Confirmations, and Trade Life Cycle

- Strong functional and technical understanding of Murex

- Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers


Must:

- previous experience, min 2yrs, with Murex Environment management

- MXTest Module (a plus)

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Good SQL, Unix , Scripting , Sybase and Oracle skills


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities


Environment Operations Consultant:

Environment deployment and Management Operations

•Deploy and manage Murex Software needed for Murex client projects using Murex tools and scripts.

•Perform basic smoke tests before delivering the needed products.

•Act as a first-level support for already deployed Murex products, re-directing and following the issues with the corresponding support teams.

•Performing system health checks and diagnostics (RAM, CPU, processes, etc.) to ensure optimal performance and uptime

•Automating routine tasks

Conversion of a customer database

•Perform database sanitization and purging procedures

•Migration sequence execution and stabilization

Setting Methodologies and Procedures

•Contribute to creating the environment and configuration management methodologies, conversion processes, communication workflows, and needed templates and documentation

•Customize and document the installation and the conversion/upgrade procedures

•Deliver needed training and best practices for Murex Clients and project teams

•Manage internal streams: contribute to creating tools, measure related KPIs, and analyze potential issues


Collaboration

•Ensures good collaboration with the project team

•Ensures good collaboration with customer


Capitalization

•Capitalizes on issues not related to a specific client

•Contributes to product evolution (feedback to product teams, follow-up on defects and issues)

Technical Skills

•Degree in Computer Science Engineering or Information Technology Engineering (or related discipline)

•Experience with scripting languages

•Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure

•Strong communication skills

•Knowledge of technical machine specifications

•Knowledge of XML manipulations

•Knowledge of UNIX Operations with hands-on expertise in command-line operations

•Knowledge of RDMS Operations

•Understanding of the Financial markets


Skills must have:

- Strong working knowledge of Murex Configuration and Environment management

- Strong knowledge of scheduler software (e.g. Tidal, Autosys, JAMS, ...etc.)

- Good understanding of MXTest

- Good product knowledge/understanding in IRD, CRD, EQD, FXD

- Good understanding of Workflows, Operations, Fixings process, Confirmations, and Trade Life Cycle

- Strong functional and technical understanding of Murex

- Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers


Must:

- previous experience, min 2yrs, with Murex Environment management

- MXTest Module (a plus)

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Good SQL, Unix , Scripting , Sybase and Oracle skills


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Vendedor
description:
Descrição da Empresa Sugerimos que insira os detalhes aqui.
Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um profissional para atuar como vendedor na mamaezen, com sede em São Luís, MA. As atividades diárias incluem atender e fidelizar clientes, oferecer suporte sobre os produtos disponíveis, operar o ponto de venda e auxiliar no controle de estoque. Este é um cargo de tempo integral, e os candidatos devem ter disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.
Qualificações

  • Atendimento ao cliente e vendas: Experiência em atendimento ao cliente e habilidades em vendas para oferecer o melhor suporte e ajudar os clientes a escolher os produtos certos.
  • Comunicação e negociação: Boa comunicação verbal, escuta ativa e habilidade em negociar, promovendo um ambiente acolhedor e adequado às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Organização e controle: Capacidade de lidar com controle de estoque, organização da loja e operação de sistemas de ponto de venda.
  • Será um diferencial ter experiência em varejo, conhecimentos no segmento de produtos para bem-estar e disposição para trabalhar em equipe.

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief
